tasks.build: deno task bundle:embed && deno task build:cli && deno task build:npm && deno task build:web
tasks.build:cli: deno task bundle:embed && cd cli && deno task build
tasks.build:npm: deno task bundle:embed && deno run -A scripts/build-npm.ts
tasks.build:web: deno task bundle:embed && cd web && deno task build
tasks.hc: deno task bundle:embed && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --deny-run --deny-ffi cli/hc.ts
tasks.hc:rest: deno task bundle:embed && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-net=api.github.com --deny-run --deny-ffi cli/hc.ts --rest cli/rest/github-live.json
tasks.publish: deno task publish:lib && deno task publish:web
tasks.publish:lib: deno task bundle:embed && cd lib && deno publish
tasks.publish:web: deno task bundle:embed && cd web && deno publish
tasks.setup: deno task bundle:embed && deno run -A deno-hooks
tasks.test: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno task check && deno task test:all
tasks.check: deno task bundle:embed && deno check --frozen cli lib scripts web experiments/006-partition-check experiments/007-observer-algebras experiments/017-classical-cd && deno check --frozen --doc-only README.md lib/README.md web/README.md && deno doc --lint lib/mod.ts lib/maml/mod.ts

tasks.test:cli: deno task bundle:embed && cd cli && deno task test
tasks.test:doc: deno task bundle:embed && cd cli && deno task test:doc
tasks.test:rest-loopback: deno task bundle:embed && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-net=127.0.0.1 cli/rest-loopback.test.ts
tasks.test:rest-live: deno task bundle:embed && deno run --allow-read --allow-run scripts/rest-live.ts
tasks.test:lib: deno task bundle:embed && deno test --parallel --ignore=lib/load-order.test.ts lib && deno task test:load-order
tasks.test:load-order: deno task bundle:embed && deno test --allow-read lib/load-order.test.ts
tasks.test:npm: deno task build:npm && deno run -A scripts/test-npm.ts
tasks.test:observer-algebras: deno task bundle:embed && deno test --allow-read experiments/007-observer-algebras
tasks.test:web: deno task bundle:embed && cd web && deno task test
tasks.bundle:embed: deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/embed-hc.ts && deno fmt --quiet lib/bundle/hc-sources.ts
tasks.test:all: deno task bundle:embed && deno task test:cli && deno task test:rest-loopback && deno task test:lib && deno task test:scripts && deno task test:partition-check && deno task test:observer-algebras && deno task test:classical-cd && deno task test:web && deno task test:doc && deno task test:npm && deno task test:compiled
